_note: Unit prices in US dollars, used only to convert measured usage counts into a spend figure. Usage counts (tokens, searches, pages) are recorded exactly; dollars are derived. Correct a price here and every past run's cost recomputes from its recorded counts — no re-run needed. Every line names where the price came from and when it was read, so a stale price is visible rather than silent.

openai._source: UNCONFIRMED — placeholder at Anthropic Opus-tier rates so the counter never reads low. Replace with the published rate for whichever model resolve_model() selects; the recorded token counts make the correction exact.

gemini._source: UNCONFIRMED — placeholder at Anthropic Opus-tier rates so the counter never reads low. Replace with the published rate for whichever model resolve_model() selects.

perplexity._source: UNCONFIRMED — placeholder at Anthropic Opus-tier rates plus a per-request search fee. Perplexity is a discovery peer only (decision C6), so its share of spend is small by construction.

exa._source: UNCONFIRMED — Exa publishes per-search and per-page-of-contents pricing. Counts are exact; correct these two numbers to make the dollars exact.

jina._source: UNCONFIRMED — Jina Reader bills per token of returned page text. Priced here per fetched page as an upper-bound placeholder.
